fields.staffing: One certified operator in the RWTP Control Room; Plant Superintendent on site; Distribution crews out; City Hall open since 08:00
fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise. It is 09:00 on Monday, October 26, 2026. Demand is normal at about 9 MGD and the Riverside Water Treatment Plant is in automatic, with one certified operator in the Control Room and the Plant Superintendent on site. City Hall opened at 08:00 and Customer Service is taking calls on the billing system. No alarms are active.

fields.load: Normal: full treatment capacity, steady demand
fields.staffing: On-shift: 1 certified operator in Control Room; 2 on-site for Plant Operations; 1 on-call for Distribution
fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise. It is 09:00 AM on a clear Monday, October 24, 2026, at the Riverside Water Treatment Plant. The Millbrook water system is operating normally. All system statuses show green. Control Room operations are on the 0600–1800 shift. The Director of Water Operations, SCADA / IT Security Manager, Public Information Officer, Water Quality Manager, and Security & Emergency Manager are all at their desks. No alarms are active. All network and control system checks are normal. The city’s business network is healthy. The system is ready for the day.

status.name: Main Treatment Process
status.note: All filters 1–6 in service, flow 12.4 MGD

status.name: Chemical Feed Systems
status.note: Alum, Caustic, Fluoride, Hypochlorite, Permanganate, Polymer all in automatic

status.name: SCADA Network
status.note: MBW-HMI-01 and MBW-HMI-02 online, no telemetry gaps

status.name: Distribution Network
status.note: Pressure zones 1–3, S all within normal range

status.name: Emergency Operations
status.note: All ICS roles on standby; no active incidents

fields.facilitatorNote: Confirm all roles have their briefing packets and ICS forms. No action required yet; the exercise has started.
